description: Seed and script of e2e/triangulation.spec.ts. Coordinates are world metres (Y up). The scan_segment calibration makes 1000 px of synthetic_sketch.png (2000 x 2828 px) span 100 mm of paper at 1:100 (provisional in the schematic sketch, declared in the scaled drawing), so the source image covers x 0..20 m and y -28.28..0 m. Two walls meet at the corner C = (4, -16) and are drawn short (5,50 m and 3,50 m, as in a sketch); their declared lengths are 6,00 m and 4,00 m. A and B are reference points at C and at the far end of wall 1 once fixed. The evidence marker is drawn near P.

triangulation.hand_calculation: |AB| = 6. Along AB from A: a = (dA^2 - dB^2 + |AB|^2) / (2 |AB|) = (12,96 - 23,04 + 36) / 12 = 2,16. Off AB: h = sqrt(dA^2 - a^2) = sqrt(12,96 - 4,6656) = 2,88 (a 3-4-5 triangle scaled by 1,2, right angle at P). Candidates (6,16, -13,12) and (6,16, -18,88); the first is nearest to the drawn marker.
